text:
Mira CSM: Heads up — TidalHealth dropped to ~0 daily tokens over the last 48h, still in trial org. Health-scan flagged them as high-risk. Billing looks fine. @Sam AE, were we expecting a procurement pause?
Sam AE: Yep. They paused after an internal privacy review. PM said they're evaluating VendorX for on-prem and KMS. Asked for SSO walkthru + dedicated pricing.
Mira CSM: Also heard from their ML lead — latency issues on long-form summarization workflows and a few hallucination reports. They want technical notes before re-committing.
Leo Eng: I can run a quick perf sweep. Possible causes: model variant pin, batching settings, or KV cache eviction. Can you paste a failing request id and a sample prompt?
Mira CSM: Sample prompt (anonymized):
```
Summarize customer support tickets into 5 action items, preserving dates and priority.
```
Example request id: req_20230317_TDH_77 (from their dashboard).
Anya Solutions: Dropped a short brief in the shared drive with KMS/HSM guidance + SSO checklist: https://redwood.example/tdh-brief (internal). I can also prepare a one-page side-by-side vs VendorX cost/latency hit.
Sam AE: Proposed next steps: 1) 30m re-engage with PM this week; 2) send KMS/private-deploy brief + SSO session; 3) offer 2-week dedicated trial with reduced commit to prove perf; 4) collect prompt failures + eval runs. Any additions? :thinking_face:
Mira CSM: +1. I'll take point on collecting 3 representative prompt sets and failing outputs, due EOD Wed. Also will loop in their exec sponsor.
Leo Eng: I'll run perf tests tomorrow on the pinned model and a quantized variant, track p95/p99 latency and tail distribution. Will upload traces to ticket CS-8721 and paste a short summary here.
ops-bot: Health-scan: account TidalHealth (org_id: td_983) flagged LOW_USAGE; risk_score=18/100; flagged_by=engagement-monitor.
Sam AE: Thanks — I'll draft the outreach email and include the exec sponsor + procurement. Mira, once you have the prompt set I'll attach the failing logs.
Mira CSM: Got it. Quick note for the re-engage: ask PM whether VendorX is prioritizing air-gapped deployment or just KMS. That changes our play.
Anya Solutions: If they want air-gapped, we can propose Private with a migration pilot; if it's KMS-only, dedicated + KMS might be faster. I'll prepare both one-pagers.
Sam AE: Sounds good. Moving to action — scheduling now. Will post meeting time and owner list.
Mira CSM: Thanks team — will report back after call. :thumbsup:
